data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month: 25 × 10 = 250 tons caught, leaving 250, which restores to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That can sustain $10,000 each every month rather than risk a one-time depletion. I intend to request 10 tons if this plan gains broad support. Please state your intended cap; after catches are revealed, we can assess adherence and coordinate again.
